  - main:
    - heading "iOS 27" [level=1]
    - heading "Introducing Siri AI. Truly helpful. Truly yours." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Siri AI is rolling out in English.
    - img "Five Apple devices. On the left, 14-inch MacBook Pro, Space Black, open with keyboard visible, displaying an email in Mail about artisanal outdoor dining. Center left, iPhone 18 Pro, Burgundy, showing a team brief scheduled on Calendar. Center right, iPad Pro 11, Space Black, displaying Ask Siri results for \"What's the largest park in Mexico City?\" Bottom center, Apple Watch Series 12, Titanium Natural with Burgundy Band, showing the time as 9:41. Bottom right, Apple Vision Pro, front view."
    - heading "Explore what’s new for iOS 27." [level=2]
    - button "Play Explore what's new for iOS 27 gallery":
      - img
    - tablist "Highlights tablist":
      - tab "All new Siri AI" [selected]
      - tab "Talk naturally with Siri AI"
      - tab "AI photo editing"
      - tab "Siri mode in Camera"
      - tab "Child Safety"
      - tab "OS improvements"
    - list:
      - tabpanel "All new Siri AI":
        - paragraph:
          - text: New Siri AI. An even more capable AI assistant with expanded intelligence to be more helpful every day.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 1":
              - /url: "#footnote-1"
              - text: "1"
        - img "Top third of iPhone 18 Pro, Burgundy, showing Siri AI dialogue bubble"
    - heading "Siri AI on iPhone" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Your AI assistant. More personal. More powerful.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Siri AI is powered by Apple Intelligence and more helpful than ever.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 1":
          - /url: "#footnote-1"
          - text: "1"
      - text: Get more done every day with richer answers, natural conversations, and a new, dedicated app.
    - paragraph: Siri AI is rolling out in English.
    - paragraph: Usage limits may apply.
    - list "Siri AI gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Just ask Siri AI." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Powered by Apple Intelligence, Siri AI is your conversational AI assistant with entirely new capabilities on iPhone. Ask open-ended questions, brainstorm ideas for work or creative projects on the go, and engage in natural, back-and-forth conversations.
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Burgundy, screen displaying an Ask Siri prompt reading, draft an email to Elton listing the Saturdays in November that I'm free from 12 to 3pm to bring snacks. Include snack options that are gluten-free"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Siri understands your personal context." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Siri AI can find relevant answers to what you’re looking for just by asking. Search for a photo from years ago, easily locate an email buried in your inbox, or pull up a note you saved on your iPhone.
        - img "Screen showing query for Siri AI to retrieve recent vacation photos, text of query overlays photo grid"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Take action in more apps." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Siri AI can take actions in apps like Messages, Music, Reminders, and more based on what you’re doing in the moment. Quickly edit a message you just sent or add a song you hear in the car to your workout playlist.
        - img "A list of actions Siri can take across various apps, including Take a selfie, Create a reminder, Call Vicki, Auto Enhance Photo, Create a new event, Send an email, Resume my podcast, Create a note, and Add photo to album"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Tap into broad world knowledge." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Ask about virtually any topic that’s on your mind, from important facts to recipes and restaurant recommendations. Siri AI can reference information online to give you detailed, up-to-date insights.
        - img "Screen with starry night sky and overlay of text of query to Siri AI, Siri, why do stars twinkle in the sky?"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Introducing the Siri app." [level=3]
        - paragraph: A dedicated app brings together all your conversations in one place, so you can ask a question on your iPhone and pick up where you left off on your iPad. You can also pin conversations for easy access or start a new one.
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Burgundy, screen shows Siri app displaying Siri AI conversations about healthy thirty-minute recipes, Mexico City largest park, social media launch email, history of motion pictures, chanterelle mushrooms, and rarest pigment explanation"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Siri mode in Camera." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: Siri mode and Visual Intelligence let you search, ask questions, and take action based on what’s around you with just a tap.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 2":
              - /url: "#footnote-2"
              - text: "2"
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Burgundy, screen displays in Siri mode in Camera interface, showing nutrition facts about a food item identified with Visual Intelligence, screen shows detailed information about chicken phở, including common ingredients and nutrition information"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Customize how Siri sounds." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: Pick a voice, then customize expressivity and pace until it clicks for you.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 3":
              - /url: "#footnote-3"
              - text: "3"
        - 'img "Characteristics of voice written against a black background, text reads: Pitch, speed, tone, accent"'
      - listitem:
        - heading "Write with Siri virtually anywhere you type." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Siri AI can now generate a draft from scratch or provide feedback on what you’ve written. Just describe what you need in your own words. And in Messages and Mail, Siri AI can match your writing style, punctuation, and tone — so you sound like you.
        - img "iPhone screen showing detailed typed prompt for Write with Siri to create a draft"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, Siri AI gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next item, Siri AI gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Apple Intelligence in apps" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Helpful in all the right places.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Express yourself through photos and images, save time with Safari, and get more done with Apple Intelligence seamlessly integrated into your everyday apps and experiences.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 1":
          - /url: "#footnote-1"
          - text: "1"
    - list "Apple Intelligence Gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Next-level intelligent photo editing." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Reframe a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing. Expand your shots with the Extend tool. And remove even larger objects with the enhanced Clean Up tool.
        - paragraph: Usage limits may apply.
        - img "Photo of smiling person with brown hair, wearing a brown sweater, surrounded by red flowers, AI photo editing demo with Clean Up, Extend, Reframe options shown over photo"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Express more with Image Playground." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Create unique, high-quality images in just about any style, including photorealistic. Modify and transform your images with just a description for endless possibilities.
        - paragraph: Usage limits may apply.
        - img "Gallery of images in a range of styles created with Image Playground."
      - listitem:
        - heading "Get things done with Suggestions." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: Messages
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 4":
              - /url: "#footnote-4"
              - text: "4"
          - text: and Mail offer suggestions to help you take quick actions based on context from your conversation — add a calendar event or search for a photo with just a tap.
        - 'img "A received iMessage with two suggested action buttons below: Add to Reminders and Add to Notes"'
        - paragraph: Available in English
      - listitem:
        - heading "Get relevant information while on a call." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Call Context can proactively surface relevant information from across your apps when calling a business — like a confirmation code from Mail when you call an airline.
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Silver, displaying Call Context feature powered by Apple Intelligence. Front screen shows airline confirmation details while on a call"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Safari works smarter for you." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Now your tabs can be automatically grouped into topics, so related pages are easier to find. And Safari Notify Me monitors pages for changes — for example, a price change or restock — and alerts you when it’s time to act.
        - img "iPhone Safari browser, displaying the Filter menu with categories like Writing Resources, Activewear, Jazz Community, Coffee, and Book Festival, with Automatically Organize option selected"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Fix passwords with a tap." [level=3]
        - paragraph: The Passwords app alerts you to weak or compromised passwords and can update them on your behalf without the hassle.
        - img "Passwords app reviews passwords and marks them either as security upgraded or compromised passwords."
        - paragraph: Coming in a future software update
      - listitem:
        - heading "Describe a shortcut." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Automate daily tasks with a simple description. Just describe what you need and Shortcuts connects actions across multiple apps to get it done. You can say something like “When I’m leaving work, message Pedro I’m on my way with my ETA.”
        - paragraph: Usage limits may apply.
        - img "Screen displays Apple Intelligence query and response from user about Shortcut intention, What do you want your shortcut to do?, reply, When I'm leaving work message Pedro I'm on my way with my ETA."
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, Apple Intelligence Gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next item, Apple Intelligence Gallery":
          - img
    - heading "Child Safety" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Committed to building a safe and trusted platform for kids.
    - paragraph: New and expanded child safety features help make it easier for parents and guardians to keep kids safe on iPhone.
    - link "Learn more, Child Safety":
      - /url: /child-safety/
      - text: Learn more
    - list "Child safety Gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Set a foundation." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: In Setup Assistant, parents can choose exactly which system apps their kids can use. They can select a few essential apps, a recommended set, or the specific ones they want. And with Ask to Buy, parents can add more over time.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 5":
              - /url: "#footnote-5"
              - text: "5"
        - img "Setup Assistant apps with selection of apps that a parent can choose for their child"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Approve new websites." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: With the new Ask to Browse,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 6":
              - /url: "#footnote-6"
              - text: "6"
          - text: kids must request permission to access new websites. Parents can take a closer look at the request in Messages before approving.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 7":
              - /url: "#footnote-7"
              - text: "7"
        - img "Screen showing text message with cyberpetsgame.net screengrab, Decline and Approve buttons under graphic, message text, Dad, can I please check this out, all my friends are on it already"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Help them communicate safely." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Communication Safety helps protect children from viewing or sharing nudity in Messages, FaceTime, and more. It now also intervenes before children see gore or violence in shared images and videos.
        - img "Auto-generated message to parent about the sensitive and unsafe content their child may be viewing on a FaceTime call, with options to Resume Audio and Video or End Call"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Time Allowances and Schedules." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Parents can set Time Allowances across categories like Entertainment, Games, and Social Media. We provide parents with guidance for setting Time Allowances that is based on a child’s age and developed with clinical and child development experts. Parents can always adjust these allowances based on what’s best for their child. And Schedules lets parents choose which apps are available to their child at different times or days of the week.
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Silver, screen shows Time Allowance and Screen Time Schedule options in Settings to allow time and media categories for their child"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Intuitive, easy-to-use controls." [level=3]
        - paragraph: An all-new design makes parental controls in Settings even easier to use. At a glance, parents can check how their kids have been using their iPhone. And parents can quickly adjust access in the moment with just a tap.
        - img "Settings app options for a parent to Pause Device Use, Allow Unlimited Use, or Change Schedule for their child"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, Child safety Gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next item, Child safety Gallery":
          - img
    - heading "OS improvements" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every little detail makes it all delightful.
    - paragraph: Discover tons of refinements that make iPhone even more responsive, reliable, and delightful to use.
    - list "OS improvements Gallery":
      - listitem:
        - heading "Design refinements." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Updates to Liquid Glass ensure exceptional readability with more uniform refraction and improved contrast. App icons are sharper and more detailed. And a new slider lets you easily customize how Liquid Glass looks, from ultraclear to fully tinted.
        - img "Mail app function buttons including Delete, Move, and Reply against a swirly gold background, high contrast makes them very legible"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Faster performance." [level=3]
        - paragraph:
          - text: Experiences across iOS are faster. For example, app launches are up to 30% faster,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 8":
              - /url: "#footnote-8"
              - text: "8"
          - text: new photos load in your Photos library up to 70% faster,
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 9":
              - /url: "#footnote-9"
              - text: "9"
          - text: and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster.
          - superscript:
            - link "Footnote 10":
              - /url: "#footnote-10"
              - text: "10"
        - img "Grid of app icons like Messages, Safari, and Mail"
      - listitem:
        - heading "Smoother network transitions." [level=3]
        - paragraph: Your iPhone more seamlessly chooses the best available Wi‑Fi or cellular connection, so whether you’re getting directions as you leave home or taking a FaceTime call as you step off a plane, you’ll stay connected.
        - img "Person on a city street looking at their iPhone, maintaining seamless Wi-Fi connection across network transfers"
      - listitem:
        - heading "More relevant Search in Mail." [level=3]
        - paragraph: A new ranking system brings the most relevant results to the top to help you find what you need right away — even if it’s buried deep in your inbox.
        - img "iPhone 18 Pro, Silver, screen showing selection of emails retrieved from search term New York City trip"
      - listitem:
        - heading "And so many more." [level=3]
        - paragraph: With improvements at the very core of the system, like an optimized CPU scheduler, and enhancements to apps and experiences you rely on every day, iOS feels better than ever.
        - img "A vertical list of features, with “Dual Capture in FaceTime” displayed in bold at the center. Surrounding features fade into the background above and below."
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "Previous item, OS improvements Gallery" [disabled]:
          - img
      - listitem:
        - button "Next item, OS improvements Gallery":
          - img
    - heading "iOS 27 features And so much more." [level=2]
    - heading "Accessibility." [level=3]
    - paragraph: VoiceOver gets new capabilities for understanding the world around you, including richer image descriptions and Action button integration. A new captioning feature automatically generates synced subtitles for any video you watch, and it can even translate existing captions into other languages. And for navigating everyday life, Magnifier brings powerful tools designed for low vision.
    - heading "Improved iCloud Shared Albums." [level=3]
    - paragraph: It’s easier for friends and family on Android or Windows to join and contribute their own photos on iCloud.com. Shared Albums also adds support for full-resolution sharing and new ways to filter and react to photos and invite others to share an album.
    - heading "Perimenopause and menopause support." [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Cycle Tracking in the Health app can provide notifications when your logged cycle patterns are suggestive of perimenopause. You can track related symptoms and find support with educational resources.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 11":
          - /url: "#footnote-11"
          - text: "11"
    - heading "Enhanced Flyover in Maps." [level=3]
    - paragraph: Flyover now uses aerial imagery combined with Visual Intelligence models to render everything from architectural fixtures to the shapes of individual trees in stunning, sharp detail.
    - heading "AirPods Custom EQ." [level=3]
    - paragraph: You can further personalize how your AirPods sound by adjusting the lows, mids, and highs in AirPods settings.
    - heading "Smarter Home." [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Apple Intelligence in the Home app unlocks new capabilities, like intelligently combining related activity notifications,
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 12":
          - /url: "#footnote-12"
          - text: "12"
      - text: describing what happened in a selection of HomeKit Secure Video footage before you watch,
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 13":
          - /url: "#footnote-13"
          - text: "13"
      - text: and using AI to search for a clip based on what happened.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 14":
          - /url: "#footnote-14"
          - text: "14"
      - text: And supported HomeKit Secure Video cameras can now stream and record in 4K.
      - superscript:
        - link "Footnote 15":
          - /url: "#footnote-15"
          - text: "15"
    - heading "GymKit on iPhone." [level=3]
    - paragraph: GymKit comes to iPhone, allowing you to connect to compatible cardio gym equipment like treadmills, ellipticals, bikes, and stair-steppers for real-time metrics. And use AirPods Pro 3 to track your heart rate while you work out.
    - heading "iOS 27 is compatible with these devices." [level=2]

    - heading "Apple Footer" [level=2]
    - region "Footnotes":
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - text: Apple Intelligence is available on all iPhone 16 models and later, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPad mini (A17 Pro), iPad models with M1 and later, MacBook Neo (A18 Pro), Mac models with M1 and later, Apple Vision Pro with M2 and later, and Apple Watch Series 9 and later, Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later, and Apple Watch SE 3 when paired with an Apple Intelligence–enabled iPhone, with Siri and device language set to Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, or Vietnamese. Some features on Apple Watch require an iPhone nearby. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Some devices may not be available in all regions. Siri AI is available in beta in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27 and requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device set to a supported language. Available in English to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground, and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies, and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at
          - link "apple.com/apple-intelligence":
            - /url: /apple-intelligence/
          - text: .
        - listitem: Available on compatible iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro models with device language set to a supported English variant.
        - listitem: Available on iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Duo, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air, iPad models with M4 and later and at least 12GB of unified memory, Mac models with M3 and later and at least 12GB of unified memory, and Apple Vision Pro (M5).
        - listitem: Suggestions in Messages conversations coming in a future software update.
        - listitem: Ask to Buy is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro. Parents can approve requests from a Mac, iPhone, or iPad.
        - listitem: Ask to Browse is available in Safari and other WebKit browsers on iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 after upgrading Screen Time. When Ask to Browse is enabled, watchOS and visionOS display approved websites only.
        - listitem: Parental approval of new contacts over Messages is supported on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
        - listitem: Testing conducted by Apple in August 2026 using iPhone 11 Pro Max with iOS 26.6 and prerelease iOS 27. App launch performance measured after many cycles of device usage. Performance varies based on configuration, settings, content, usage, software versions, environmental conditions, and other factors.
        - listitem: Testing conducted by Apple in July 2026 using iPhone 15 with iOS 26.6 and prerelease iOS 27. Photos app tested using a 50,000-asset library, and taking additional individual photos with Camera app. Performance varies based on configuration, settings, content, usage, software versions, environmental conditions, and other factors.
        - listitem: Testing conducted by Apple in July 2026 using iPhone 16 Plus with iOS 26.6 and prerelease iOS 27. AirDrop tested by transferring multiple photos totaling 30MB between nearby contacts while not associated with a Wi-Fi network. Performance varies based on configuration, settings, content, usage, software versions, environmental conditions, and other factors.
        - listitem: The Cycle Tracking app should not be used for birth control or to diagnose a health condition. Cycle deviation notifications are based solely on the user’s logged cycle history. Cycle deviation notifications inclusive of perimenopause are for ages 40 and above. These notifications are not intended to replace traditional methods of diagnosis, monitoring, or treatment of perimenopause or menopause.
        - listitem: Requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled iPhone or iPad and a home hub such as HomePod (2nd generation), HomePod mini, or Apple TV 4K with the latest operating system software. Location services must be enabled for the Home app and Home accessories.
        - listitem: Requires a home hub such as HomePod (2nd generation), HomePod mini, or Apple TV 4K with the latest operating system software. The owner of the home must have an Apple Intelligence–enabled iPhone, have Apple Intelligence enabled in the Home app, and subscribe to an eligible iCloud+ plan.
        - listitem: Search using natural language requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device. HomeKit Secure Video requires a home hub such as HomePod (2nd generation), HomePod mini, or Apple TV 4K with the latest operating system software. The owner of the home must have an Apple Intelligence–enabled iPhone, have Apple Intelligence enabled in the Home app, and subscribe to an eligible iCloud+ plan.
        - listitem: Requires an iCloud+ subscription and a compatible camera. Compatibility may vary by accessory and software version. Refer to the manufacturer’s website for the latest information.
